Team —

Quick one: finance flagged a measurable drift in the mid‑market cohort close dates versus committed quarter for Q3. The spike looks concentrated in deals flagged as "commit" with close dates pushed 30–90 days after the AE last updated stage. We need a fast sweep to avoid an inflated Q3 forecast.

What I need from each AE owning a mid‑market deal by EOD Monday:
- Verify "Close Date" matches customer‑confirmed timeline OR move to OPP‑AT‑RISK if not confirmed.
- Confirm Stage is correct (Proposal / Legal / Commitment) and leave a 1‑line rational in the SF Notes field (e.g., "confirmed 8/15 on 6/23 call").
- If you need help getting confirmation, mark the deal as "Needs Exec Help" and include a short action item.

I've attached a quick audit CSV (midmarket_close_audit.csv) with the filtered cohort and the top 3 fields to reconcile (Owner, Close Date, Stage). Please run the audit row for your deals and update SF directly — do not re‑attach the CSV to PRs.

Why this matters: we have two finance checkpoints next week. If we carry drift into the official commit, QBR will under/overstate capacity and the ops plan shifts. Simple hygiene here saves painful downstream conversations.

If you want a 15‑minute drop‑in, I'll run a rolling slack huddle at 11:00 PT today and drop the calendar invite.

Thanks —
Jordan
